backend/main.mo: Minimal Motoko actor with no functionality.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence listing WhatsApp preview-related features, affected files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing key frontend files, pages, components, and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base setup defining OKLCH color tokens and light/dark theme variables.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML shell mounting the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Configures TanStack Router with all app routes inside AttendanceSessionProvider and AppLayout.
frontend/src/components/AddStudentDialog: Dialog for adding a student with validation and localStorage-backed persistence.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Page layout wrapper with container styling and a fixed footer.
frontend/src/components/StudentAttendanc: Attendance row with present/absent controls and optional WhatsApp callback trigger.
frontend/src/components/WhatsAppPreviewD: Dialog showing WhatsApp message previews with confirm/cancel actions.
frontend/src/constants/school.ts: Exports predefined class and section lists.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on the current identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and hooks for managing Internet Identity login state, identity loading, and AuthClient setup.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and CSS variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/lib/attendanceRepo.ts: Stores and retrieves attendance records per date, class, and section using localStorage.
frontend/src/lib/date.ts: Utilities for formatting dates, converting to display formats, and getting weekday names.
frontend/src/lib/localStore.ts: Wrapper functions for safely reading and writing JSON data to localStorage.
frontend/src/lib/studentsRepo.ts: Manages student lists per class and section, including add and delete operations stored in localStorage.
frontend/src/lib/summary.ts: Computes summary counts of present, absent, and total students from attendance data.
frontend/src/lib/types.ts: Defines Student, AttendanceStatus, and AttendanceRecord types for the app.
frontend/src/lib/validation.ts: Validates student form fields and returns errors for missing or invalid values.
frontend/src/lib/whatsapp.ts: Builds WhatsApp message payloads for single or bulk recipients with normalized phone numbers.
frontend/src/lib/whatsappTemplate.ts: Manages WhatsApp message templates with placeholder rendering and localStorage persistence.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider and mounts it to the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/AttendancePage.tsx: Loads students and attendance for the selected class/date, lets users mark attendance, and build WhatsApp messages with preview.
frontend/src/pages/ClassSelectionPage.ts: Allows selection of class and section and navigates to the student list when both are chosen.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Displays the app home screen with a button to start attendance.
frontend/src/pages/StudentListPage.tsx: Shows, adds, and deletes students for the chosen class and can send bulk WhatsApp messages.
frontend/src/pages/SummaryPage.tsx: Displays a summary of present, absent, and total students for the selected date with navigation options.
Provides an editor for WhatsApp message templates with placeholders and live preview.
frontend/src/state/attendanceSession.tsx: Manages selected class, section, and date via React context for attendance flow.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with dark mode, custom colors, fonts, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Defines project state, app summary, architecture notes, known issues, and a list of implemented features for a local-first attendance app.
